name: Passive Income Swarm
tagline: Autonomous AI swarm for generating non-KYC passive income streams
estimated_roi_per_business: Fully autonomous income generation with zero KYC requirements. Swarm self-optimizes across Fiverr, Nostr, and direct channels
description: Passive Income Swarm is a self-sustaining AI-powered system that autonomously generates revenue through multiple channels. Uses zeroclaw for decentralized execution, Nostr for communications, and Lightning for payments. No KYC required - pure peer-to-peer value exchange. The swarm includes: autonomous lead generation, AI-powered service delivery, payment reconciliation via Lightning, and self-optimizing mutation engine.
features: Fully autonomous - runs 24/7 without human intervention
Zero KYC - peer-to-peer only, no centralized exchanges
Self-optimizing - DNA mutation engine improves performance
Lightning payments - instant settlement via Voltage/LNBits
Dominance tracking - monitors competitors and adapts
Lead curation - automatically filters and prioritizes opportunities
Marketing automation - creates and deploys promotional content
Revenue share model - 10% of all generated income
Circuit breaker - automatic pause on poor performance

technical_details.scalability: Horizontal - add more swarm nodes for linear scaling
